p.src: 1  The Song of songs, which is Solomon’s.

en: The Song of songs, which is Solomon’s.
u.src: 1  The Song of songs, which is Solomon’s.

p.src: 2  Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth; for your love is better than wine.

ja: づけしてくれますように。 あなたの
en: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth; for your love is better than wine.
u.src: 2  Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth; for your love is better than wine.

p.src: 3  Your oils have a pleasing fragrance. Your name is oil poured out, therefore the virgins love you.

ja: は心地よい香りを放つ。 あなたの
のよう。 それゆえ、おとめたちはあなたを
en: Your oils have a pleasing fragrance. Your name is oil poured out, therefore the virgins love you.
u.src: 3  Your oils have a pleasing fragrance. Your name is oil poured out, therefore the virgins love you.

p.src: 4  Take me away with you. Let’s hurry. The king has brought me into his rooms. Friends We will be glad and rejoice in you. We will praise your love more than wine! Beloved They are right to love you.

ja: を連れて行ってください。 一緒に急ごう。
れて来た。 友人たち
たちはあなたのことで
をぶどう酒以上にほめたたえよう。 愛する女 彼女たちがあなたを
en: Take me away with you. Let’s hurry. The king has brought me into his rooms. Friends We will be glad and rejoice in you. We will praise your love more than wine! Beloved They are right to love you.
u.src: 4  Take me away with you. Let’s hurry. The king has brought me into his rooms. Friends We will be glad and rejoice in you. We will praise your love more than wine! Beloved They are right to love you.

p.src: 5  I am dark, but lovely, you daughters of Jerusalem, like Kedar’s tents, like Solomon’s curtains.

ja: 私の肌は黒いが、美しい。 エルサレムの
のように、 ソロモンの
en: I am dark, but lovely, you daughters of Jerusalem, like Kedar’s tents, like Solomon’s curtains.
u.src: 5  I am dark, but lovely, you daughters of Jerusalem, like Kedar’s tents, like Solomon’s curtains.

p.src: 6  Don’t stare at me because I am dark, because the sun has scorched me. My mother’s sons were angry with me. They made me keeper of the vineyards. I haven’t kept my own vineyard.

en: Don’t stare at me because I am dark, because the sun has scorched me. My mother’s sons were angry with me. They made me keeper of the vineyards. I haven’t kept my own vineyard.
u.src: 6  Don’t stare at me because I am dark, because the sun has scorched me. My mother’s sons were angry with me. They made me keeper of the vineyards. I haven’t kept my own vineyard.

p.src: 7  Tell me, you whom my soul loves, where you graze your flock, where you rest them at noon; for why should I be as one who is veiled beside the flocks of your companions?

ja: えてください。 あなたはどこで群れに草を食べさせ、
れのそばで、 顔を覆う女のようでなければならないのか。
en: Tell me, you whom my soul loves, where you graze your flock, where you rest them at noon; for why should I be as one who is veiled beside the flocks of your companions?
u.src: 7  Tell me, you whom my soul loves, where you graze your flock, where you rest them at noon; for why should I be as one who is veiled beside the flocks of your companions?

p.src: 8  If you don’t know, most beautiful among women, follow the tracks of the sheep. Graze your young goats beside the shepherds’ tents.

ja: らないのなら、 羊の
のそばで、子やぎに草を食べさせよ。
en: If you don’t know, most beautiful among women, follow the tracks of the sheep. Graze your young goats beside the shepherds’ tents.
u.src: 8  If you don’t know, most beautiful among women, follow the tracks of the sheep. Graze your young goats beside the shepherds’ tents.

p.src: 9  I have compared you, my love, to a steed in Pharaoh’s chariots.

ja: よ、私はあなたを、 ファラオの
en: I have compared you, my love, to a steed in Pharaoh’s chariots.
u.src: 9  I have compared you, my love, to a steed in Pharaoh’s chariots.

p.src: 10  Your cheeks are beautiful with earrings, your neck with strings of jewels.

ja: 耳飾りをつけたあなたの
しく、 宝石を連ねたあなたの
en: Your cheeks are beautiful with earrings, your neck with strings of jewels.
u.src: 10  Your cheeks are beautiful with earrings, your neck with strings of jewels.

p.src: 11  We will make you earrings of gold, with studs of silver.

ja: 私たちはあなたのために、
en: We will make you earrings of gold, with studs of silver.
u.src: 11  We will make you earrings of gold, with studs of silver.

p.src: 12  While the king sat at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance.

en: While the king sat at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance.
u.src: 12  While the king sat at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance.

p.src: 13  My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh, that lies between my breasts.

en: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh, that lies between my breasts.
u.src: 13  My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh, that lies between my breasts.

p.src: 14  My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms from the vineyards of En Gedi.

ja: は、私にとって、 エン・ゲディのぶどう畑に
en: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms from the vineyards of En Gedi.
u.src: 14  My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms from the vineyards of En Gedi.

p.src: 15  Behold, you are beautiful, my love. Behold, you are beautiful. Your eyes are like doves.

en: Behold, you are beautiful, my love. Behold, you are beautiful. Your eyes are like doves.
u.src: 15  Behold, you are beautiful, my love. Behold, you are beautiful. Your eyes are like doves.

ja: 1:15 「見よ」は、ヘブライ語「הִנֵּה」に由来し、「目を留めよ」「注目せよ」などの意味を持つ間投詞である。
en: 1:15 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

p.src: 16  Behold, you are beautiful, my beloved, yes, pleasant; and our couch is verdant.

ja: しく、まことに慕わしい。 私たちの
en: Behold, you are beautiful, my beloved, yes, pleasant; and our couch is verdant.
u.src: 16  Behold, you are beautiful, my beloved, yes, pleasant; and our couch is verdant.

p.src: 17  The beams of our house are cedars. Our rafters are firs.

en: The beams of our house are cedars. Our rafters are firs.
u.src: 17  The beams of our house are cedars. Our rafters are firs.
